description: The Mekong River Commission Data Portal offers the commission's data and information services for the Mekong basin. The time-series service lets users search, plot and request hydro-meteorological, historical climate and water quality series; the portal counts 487 monitoring stations and 1,976 time series. Monitoring services cover hydrology and river levels, flood monitoring and forecasting, drought, discharge and sediment, environmental health, water quality, fisheries and reservoir monitoring, and information services include a hydropower database, the PNPCA project database and land cover. A map service displays frequently requested spatial datasets. Coverage is the Mekong basin in the countries the fee page names, Cambodia, Lao PDR, Thailand and Viet Nam. Access is through an online portal with registration for requests; the public account needs no licence while research and commercial users receive MRC data use licences. Caveats: the fee table lists 2.5 USD for hydro-meteorological datasets and handling and shipping fees, so not all data are free. Simulation uses: basin flood and drought modelling, reservoir and hydropower operation, and transboundary water allocation. Related records: the NTU Mekong dams database (data-mekong-dams-database-ntu) and Thaiwater (data-thaiwater-national-hydroinformatics-data-center).
